title: National Housing Development Authority (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE NATIONAL HOUSING DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT, No. 17 OF 1979

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

quality_flags.issue: Section 5 inserts a Second Schedule into the principal enactment. The LankaLaw HTML this tree was parsed from ends at the word 'Schedules' and prints no Schedule body. The Government Printer PDF (incoming/30-1999-national-housing-development-authority-act-amendment.pdf, 14 pp., text layer) prints it at pp.11-12 (two affidavit forms). check_parse_coverage against that PDF: 2740 words in the source, 723 unmatched (26.39%), essentially the Schedule and the running headers. Sections 1-6 themselves are all present in the HTML and the tree.
